capabilities: Style ordered lists with inline numbering directives such as {A}, {i}, or {01}
Set a separate numbering style per level in nested lists
Render list styles in Reading view and Live Preview while keeping plain Markdown
Escape directives as literal text using inline code spans
disambiguation: Not a checkbox or task-list tool; it only changes the numbering style of ordered lists.
extras: Users of the earlier ordered-list-style build must remove that plugin folder before installing; only Desktop 1.13.7 on Windows is verified, and mobile and third-party themes are untested.
intentEvidence: More Lists is a new implementation for current Obsidian and does not copy that plugin's source.
motivation: The author built a new implementation of the inline directive idea because the original plugin erykwalder/obsidian-list-style last released in 2022 and needed updating for current Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian renders ordered lists with a fixed numbering style, so users cannot give lists or nested levels letters, Roman numerals, or other CSS numbering types while keeping plain Markdown.

relations.evidence: The inline directive idea comes from erykwalder/obsidian-list-style, whose last release was in 2022.

summary: Ordered-list numbering styles for Obsidian: add inline directives like {A}, {i}, or {lower-greek} to lists, rendered in Reading view and Live Preview.
